items.title: A closer look at Anthropic's 2025 losses, Dan Ives discusses AI safety risks
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi takes on the biggest stories as the trading day kicks off, weighing in on Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) leaked IPO prospectus and Advanced Micro Devices' (AMD) deal to acquire World Labs. Yorkville Ives partner and senior managing director Dan Ives sits down with Sozzi for a conversation about the latest developments and safety concerns emerging from the AI space.

items.title: Apple To Sell 6 Million iPhone Duos In 2026
items.summary: Apple's priciest iPhone yet carries a sticker shock that would make most buyers flinch, but analysts say millions of customers are lining up anyway. The real question is whether Apple can actually build enough of them to meet demand.

items.title: Apple Launches Mobile Payment Services in India
items.summary: Users in India can now use Apple Pay on iPhones, iPads and Apple Watches via a partnership with Axis Bank, one of the largest private-sector lenders in the country.

items.title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro sales rise 12% in China launch week - Counterpoint
items.summary: Investing.com -- Apple's iPhone 18 Pro series sales in China rose 12% year-over-year in the first week of launch, helping the company take the top spot in the country's smartphone market, according to Counterpoint Research.
